ui.lema: The Sunken Forest. Atlantis did not sink: it fell asleep. You wake it.
ui.flujo_t: Volatile data in the pipes: it evaporates if unused
ui.alerta_p: Cold water is pouring into the outer ruins. Every cycle left unrepaired takes integrity from the Core.
ui.mapa_nota: The fog covers what no Atlantean has explored yet.
ui.d3: Steam Server 2 stopped at 5 h 40 min: out of BIOMASS
ui.dormias_nota: Sleep counts for up to 24 h. After that, the forest waits.
ui.nucleo_p: {a} / {b} community XP · 37 Atlanteans contributed in the last 7 days · your share: {tu} XP ({pct}%)
ui.desbloqueo: Level 35 unlocks: one more Steam Server slot
ui.nucleo_nota: The community rises because many contribute, not because one person grinds. Sample: the unlock table will live in mente/doctrina.md.
ui.pie: MOCKUP · sample data, no server, no network. The buttons only write to the console.
ui.dlg_l1: You're awake. Good: the forest was starting to forget your name.
ui.dlg_l2: The rift at 120 m is letting cold water into the outer ruins. Every cycle it stays open, the Core loses integrity.
ui.dlg_l3: Take the Forge's copper plates down with you. Seal it, and the whole village breathes easier.
ui.atlas_retrato_alt: Pixel-art portrait of the Preceptor: a marble bust with half its face in copper and one eye glowing violet; on alert, the eye burns copper.
